senses.gloss: f. (= h. זוֹ, זֹאת) this; with prefix ה, (הֲדָא) הָדָא, cmp. אָדָא I.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:23">Targ. Gen. II, 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 41a:2">Ned. 41ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>דְּדָא ביה וכ׳</he> in whom there is this (wisdom), in him there is everything.—<he>דא ודא</he> this and that, both.
<cite ref="Shabbat 52b:17">Sabb. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ וד׳</he> (<he>אחת</he>) <he>חדא היא</he> all sorts of rings come under the same law; a. fr.—

Y. Succ. I, 52ᶜ top הדא אמרה היא הדא וכ׳ this proves &c., v. אָדָא I.—הדא היא דכתיב (abbr. הה״ד) it is this which Scripture says, thus we read. Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ bot.; Gen. R. s. 2; a. v. fr.—Y. Gitt. IV, 45ᵈ bot. introduced his lecture בדה with this.—לא בְדָא not in this case, i.e. the law does not apply to this. Y. Ber. I, 2ᵇ bot.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:13:2">Y. Taan. II, 66ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לא בדא הלכה וכ׳</he> not in this case is the practice in agreement with the anonymous opinion.
